file: Recovery Workbench Batch and Scheduling Design v6.docx
before: Quartz and Spring Batch stay for every Epic 1 and Epic 2 scheduled job: JOB-03 allocation, JOB-04 reconciliation, JOB-05 timer check, JOB-06 rebalance, JOB-07, JOB-08 and the rest. after: Every job runs in the service that owns it as a Temporal Schedule or an event-started workflow. Quartz and Spring Batch do not run Workbench jobs; JOB-05 is retired. Each service uses its task queue in namespace rwb-recovery, with one workflow history per run (D-RCV-60; ADR-016).

file: Recovery Workbench Batch and Scheduling Design v6.docx
before: Quartz in the ACE service holds the schedules in ACE's existing qrtz_* tables, shared with ACE; one run per job across service instances. The Workbench creates no new qrtz_ table.

file: Recovery Workbench Batch and Scheduling Design v6.docx

after: A Temporal workflow history records each run. For rwb-source-data, GET /admin/jobs lists one row per run for AceIngestCheck, ReconciliationWorkflow, Stage2ProductWorkflow and RetentionRunWorkflow; other services own their job runs.

file: Recovery Workbench Batch and Scheduling Design v6.docx

file: Recovery Workbench Batch and Scheduling Design v6.docx

file: Recovery Workbench Batch and Scheduling Design v6.docx

A run with no version due changes nothing, and a second run on the same day is a no-op.
